analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, ADX 추세 미약
analysis.scoreReasonEn: RSI in oversold, weak ADX trend
analysis.reason: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 유지. 금일 RSI 36.1로 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 히스토그램 개선세는 미약하나 음수 구간에서 바닥 다지기 시도. ADX 24.3으로 추세 형성 초기 단계로 방향성 확정은 이르다. 5일 저가와 20일 저가가 1,027,000원으로 동일하여 Higher Low 패턴 확인. 변동성 ATR 101,297원 대비 손절폭 1.3배(131,686원) 설정 시 진입가 1,053,000원 기준 손절 921,314원, 목표 1,200,000원 설정 시 손익비 1.51. 그러나 추세 미형성 구간이므로 관망 유지.
analysis.reasonEn: The previous 3 trading days maintained a wait-and-see approach. Today, RSI entered oversold territory at 36.1, and while the MACD histogram improvement is weak, it attempts to bottom out in negative territory. ADX is at 24.3, an early stage of trend formation, making direction confirmation premature. The 5-day and 20-day lows are identical at 1,027,000, confirming a Higher Low pattern. With ATR at 101,297, setting a stop loss at 1.3x ATR (131,686) from the entry price of 1,053,000 would place the stop at 921,314, and a target of 1,200,000 yields a risk-reward ratio of 1.51. However, given the unformed trend, a wait-and-see approach is maintained.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (1,053,000 KRW) vs SMA5 (1,113,800 KRW) / SMA20 (1,231,600 KRW) / SMA50 (1,446,400 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term trends, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100 (1,608,865 KRW) / SMA200 (1,532,407 KRW): Below long-term trends, maintaining weak strength.
· 52-week position (21.4%) + Current price level is about twice the 52-week low, near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.4→36.1): Entering oversold territory, continued downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-6177.9987→-2267.3293): Improving in negative territory, attempting to build a base.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 956,216 KRW): Approaching the lower band, potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (808,000 KRW): Based on Pivot S1 (842,333 KRW) and 52-week low (525,000 KRW).
· Swing resistance (1,060,000 KRW): First resistance zone on short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low confirmed): Support at lows confirmed, suggesting potential for rebound.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.13x): Normal level, moderate confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): RSI entering oversold and MACD showing improvement, early trend formation stage meets conditions for observation.
